<!-- One or two sentences explaining what and why. -->

## Related issue

<!-- Fixes #123 or references #456. -->

## Type of change

- [ ] feat: new feature
- [ ] fix: bug fix
- [ ] refactor: internal change, no behavior change
- [ ] docs: documentation only
- [ ] chore: tooling, deps
- [ ] ci: pipeline change
- [ ] perf: measurable performance improvement
- [ ] test: adds or changes tests

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated for changed behavior
- [ ] a11y assertions present for component changes
- [ ] Storybook updated for `packages/ui` changes
- [ ] ADR added or referenced for architectural decisions
- [ ] Docs updated (`docs/ds/` for DS, `docs/adr/` for decisions, `README` if user-facing)
- [ ] Commit messages follow Conventional Commits, lowercase subjects
- [ ] `pnpm turbo run lint typecheck test build` passes locally
- [ ] `pnpm --filter @frontend-arch-poc/shell e2e` passes locally (if shell touched)
